name: IEEE Common Core Ontologies Standards Working Group
summary: Draft a Common Core Ontologies standard that extends the foundation established by the BFO ISO standard.
participation: Contact Brenda Braitling or use the expression-of-interest route on the IEEE working-group website. Confirm the applicable membership and participation requirements.
cadence: Contact the organizers for the current schedule.
context: IEEE identifies P3195.1 as the Common Core Ontology project within its Ontology Standards Working Group. The project is described as extending and conforming to BFO; it is distinct from the broader P3195 requirements project.
